title: Extract a Db2-quirk workaround seam in repositories/base.py
summary: Isolate the 5 documented Db2-version-specific SQL workarounds (vector literal inlining, JSON_VALUE segfault bypass, two-step distance query, zero-vector filtering, missing partial indexes) behind one seam so a future Db2 fixpack fix is a one-place change, not an archaeology project through base.py.
description:
`repositories/base.py` currently scatters 5 distinct Db2-version-specific SQL workarounds across ~2000 lines with no common seam:

1. Vector param binding unsupported (`SQL0901N`) → literal inlining via `CAST('{vec}' AS VECTOR(...))` (~lines 46-60, 1002, 1313, 1776, 1794).
2. `JSON_VALUE(col,path) = ?` segfaults the ibm_db C extension → metadata-filter values inlined as escaped literals instead of bound params (lines 291-343).
3. `VECTOR_SERIALIZE()` + `VECTOR_DISTANCE()` can't combine in one statement → two-step rank-then-fetch query (~lines 1758-1812).
4. Zero-vector rows cause `SQL0801N` in `VECTOR_DISTANCE` → filtered out of `ORDER BY` explicitly (~lines 1769-1776).
5. Partial/filtered indexes unsupported (`SQL0104N`) → `WHERE expires_at IS NOT NULL` dropped from all 5 TTL indexes.

Introduce a small internal collection (e.g. a `Db2Quirks` module or a set of clearly-named helper functions) that each of the 5 call sites routes through, with each workaround carrying an inline comment/docstring naming the exact Db2 SQLSTATE/error code (SQL0901N, the JSON_VALUE segfault, SQL0801N, SQL0104N) and the Db2 version it was observed on, so a later engineer can grep for the error code and know exactly what to re-test before removing the workaround.

Explicitly out of scope: a full pluggable storage-backend abstraction. This story is containment of the existing, already-documented quirks only — not speculative multi-database support. Do not introduce a `StorageBackend` interface or touch adapter code.

Acceptance: all 5 workarounds route through the new seam; each carries an inline comment naming its Db2 error code and the Db2 version/fixpack it targets; `tests/test_repositories.py`, `tests/integration/test_hybrid_search.py`, and the rest of the existing unit/integration suite pass unchanged with no behavior change.
